description: Expose the in-process benchmark app as a first-class discovery target `explore --target benchmark`, depending on the FEAT-001 registry. Add src/benchmark-adapter.js (BenchmarkAdapter) satisfying the runner's adapter contract over src/discovery-benchmark.js's benchmarkApplication() with no Docker; register `benchmark` -> BenchmarkAdapter in src/targets.js with policyId 'benchmark-discovery' and adapterId 'benchmark'. Add the `--target <name>` flag to src/cli.js (default `dad`) and wire it into executeDiscovery; `explore --target benchmark` must run WITHOUT Docker and WITHOUT a model key for the non-live smoke path. `run` and `explore` keep defaulting to `dad` so all existing invocations are unchanged.
steps: Create src/benchmark-adapter.js (ESM). Import { benchmarkApplication, benchmarkSource, benchmarkContract } from './discovery-benchmark.js', { digest } from './core.js', and node:fs/promises mkdir/writeFile + node:path. Class BenchmarkAdapter { constructor(run, { signal } = {}) { this.run = run; this.signal = signal; this.source = path.join(run.dir, 'source'); } }. Implement provisioning: snapshot(result) instantiates `this.app = await benchmarkApplication('healthy')`, sets `this.publicOrigin = this.app.origin`, sets run.data.candidate = { revision: digest(benchmarkSource + benchmarkContract).slice(0,40), source: 'benchmark:synthetic-profile' }, writes README.md (benchmarkContract) and profile.js (benchmarkSource) into this.source (mkdir mode 0o700, files mode 0o600 — mirror scripts/benchmark-discovery.js), and pushes candidate.json evidence via run.evidence. docker/build/database/deploy(result) are lightweight: push the evidence log files their policy checks require (docker -> docker.log + compose-version.log; build -> build-api.log + build-web.log; database -> migrations.log + test-migrations.log; deploy -> readiness.log) each with content like 'Not applicable: in-process benchmark.' and return a { summary } string. discoveryFixture() returns this.app.actors, adding cookieName 'session' to the two donor actors that carry cookie test-a/test-b (guest unchanged). discoveryReplayFixture() returns this.app.fixture. cleanup(result) awaits this.app?.close() and pushes cleanup.log. Confirm publicOrigin (http://127.0.0.1:PORT) satisfies discovery-browser.js's loopback origin check (http, 127.0.0.1, has port, pathname '/').

Edit src/targets.js: add the `benchmark` entry -> { adapterFactory: (run, options) => new BenchmarkAdapter(run, options), policyId: 'benchmark-discovery', adapterId: 'benchmark' }, importing BenchmarkAdapter from './benchmark-adapter.js'. (If FEAT-001 already added a lazy benchmark entry, replace it with the real import now.)

Edit src/cli.js: add `target: { type: 'string', default: 'dad' }` to the parseArgs options; add a `--target <name>` line to the help text. Validate the target with resolveTarget(values.target) (import from './targets.js') so an unknown target errors early. Reject a non-dad target on the `run` command: if `!discovery && values.target !== 'dad'` throw a clear error. For `explore`, relax the `--repo` requirement when target !== 'dad' (benchmark provisions in-process) — restructure the `!values.repo` guard so `explore --target benchmark` works with no --repo, while `run` and `explore --target dad` still require --repo. Pass `target: values.target` into the executeDiscovery call.

Add test/benchmark-adapter.test.js (node:test, no model/API key, no Docker): construct a minimal fake run object ({ dir: <tmpdir>, data: { id, options: { mode: 'exploration' } }, evidence: async (name, body) => ..., reference: ... } — study how test/discovery.test.js and src/core.js Run shape evidence; prefer using a real Run.create(tmpdir, { mode: 'exploration' }, ['discovery']) if simpler). Call snapshot (and deploy) then assert: new URL(adapter.publicOrigin) is http on 127.0.0.1 with a port and pathname '/'; a fetch(adapter.publicOrigin) resolves to a response (server reachable); discoveryFixture() returns a guest plus two donor actors, the donor actors carry cookie 'test-a'/'test-b' and a cookieName; then cleanup() closes the server (a follow-up fetch rejects). Use t.after to close the app if the test aborts early. Do NOT call a model.
Verify the whole suite stays green and the benchmark smoke runs with no API key and Docker stopped.
acceptance_criteria: `npm test` passes all unit tests including test/benchmark-adapter.test.js.

resolveTarget('benchmark') returns a BenchmarkAdapter factory with policyId 'benchmark-discovery' and adapterId 'benchmark'; discoveryPolicy('benchmark').definition.id === 'benchmark-discovery' and .adapter === 'benchmark'.

`node src/cli.js explore --target benchmark --max-requests 1` reaches provisioning without Docker and without a model key (it will end inconclusive/fail at the model step, which is expected — no live call), and `run`/`explore` without --target still require --repo and target dad.
DAD invocations are unchanged: `explore` and `run` default to target dad.
findings: src/benchmark-adapter.js (new, ESM): exports class BenchmarkAdapter { constructor(run, { signal } = {}) } matching the (run, options) factory contract. snapshot(result) awaits benchmarkApplication('healthy'), sets this.publicOrigin = this.app.origin (http://127.0.0.1:PORT, pathname '/'), sets run.data.candidate = { revision: digest(benchmarkSource + benchmarkContract).slice(0,40), source: 'benchmark:synthetic-profile' }, mkdir(this.source, 0o700) + writes README.md (benchmarkContract) and profile.js (benchmarkSource) at 0o600 (mirrors scripts/benchmark-discovery.js), and pushes candidate.json evidence. docker/build/database/deploy delegate to a private notApplicable(result, logs, summary) helper that writes each policy-required evidence log with body 'Not applicable: in-process benchmark.' and returns { summary }; log names match policy.js evidenceRequirements exactly (docker -> docker.log/compose-version.log; build -> build-api.log/build-web.log; database -> migrations.log/test-migrations.log; deploy -> readiness.log). discoveryFixture() returns this.app.actors with cookieName:'session' spread onto the two cookie-bearing donors only (guest untouched) — matches benchmarkApplication's cookie-VALUE auth (test-a/test-b). discoveryReplayFixture() returns this.app.fixture (in-process snapshot/restore/inspect, no Docker). cleanup(result) awaits this.app?.close() and writes cleanup.log. publicOrigin satisfies discovery-browser.js's loopback check (http, 127.0.0.1, has port, pathname '/') — asserted in the test. src/targets.js: added `benchmark -> { adapterFactory: (run, options) => new BenchmarkAdapter(run, options), policyId: 'benchmark-discovery', adapterId: 'benchmark' }` with a static import of BenchmarkAdapter (FEAT-001 had registered no benchmark entry, lazy or otherwise). src/cli.js: added `target: { type: 'string', default: 'dad' }` to parseArgs and a `--target NAME` help line; imports resolveTarget from ./targets.js and calls it early so an unknown target errors before dispatch; rejects `run` with a non-dad target ('run targets DAD only...'); split the old combined guard so --repo is only required when target==='dad' (run and explore --target dad still require --repo; explore --target benchmark runs with no --repo); passes `target: values.target` into the executeDiscovery/executeRun call (executeRun ignores it; run is already locked to dad). test/benchmark-adapter.test.js (new, 2 tests, no model/API key, no Docker): uses a real Run.create(tmpdir,{mode:'exploration'},['discovery']); asserts publicOrigin is http/127.0.0.1/port/pathname '/', fetch(publicOrigin) is reachable, deploy records readiness.log, discoveryFixture() yields guest + donor-a(cookie test-a, cookieName session) + donor-b(cookie test-b, cookieName session), discoveryReplayFixture().inspect is a function, and cleanup() closes the server (follow-up fetch rejects); plus resolveTarget('benchmark')/discoveryPolicy('benchmark') identity assertions. t.after closes the app if the test aborts early. Verification (OPENAI_API_KEY and ATM_MODEL unset, Docker not required): `npm run lint` clean (biome --error-on-warnings, 68 files); `npm test` 107 pass / 0 fail (FEAT-001 left 105; +2 new); `node --test test/benchmark-adapter.test.js` 2 pass. Smoke: `node src/cli.js explore --target benchmark --max-requests 1` fails fast at the model-config step ('Configure OPENAI_API_KEY and --model...') BEFORE any provisioning or live call — note: executeDiscovery's modelConfig check runs before snapshot by design (fail before building images), so the benchmark provisioning path is not reached without a model key via the CLI; the adapter's provisioning/teardown is fully exercised by the unit test instead. `run` with no --repo and `run --target benchmark` both error as specified; DAD invocations default to target dad and are unchanged.
